title: Preallocate DDL table index prefixes
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when DDL table operations build index:<table>: and index:<table>:<column>: prefixes from known name lengths.
implementation: Added table_index_prefix_for_table() with explicit capacity for index:<table>:.
Added table_index_prefix_for_column() with explicit capacity for index:<table>:<column>:.
Replaced DROP TABLE index cleanup prefix construction.
Replaced TRUNCATE TABLE index cleanup prefix construction.
Replaced ALTER TABLE ADD PRIMARY KEY secondary BTree index row-id rewrite prefix construction.
Added unit coverage for helper outputs and capacities.
Added SQL coverage for ADD PRIMARY KEY after a secondary BTree index already exists.
result: DDL table index-prefix construction now reserves capacity from known table and column name lengths while preserving index cleanup and secondary-index row-id rewrite behavior.
